purpose: Test whether recent pitch changes help predict a major-league injured-list placement in the next 30 days, beyond current pitch characteristics, results, workload and injury history, and beyond a simple fastball velocity change.
population: The study's eligible weekly forecast rows (data/processed/forecast_rows_2026.parquet), excluding rows where the pitcher was already placed on the injured list between his last appearance and the forecast date. No follow-up innings are required.

labels.source: MLB Stats API transactions (sportId 1), saved per season under data/raw/transactions/.
labels.placement: Descriptions matching 'placed ... on the 10-, 15- or 60-day injured list', excluding transfers and COVID-19 lists; records without a person id are dropped.
labels.event_date: The 'retroactive to' date in the description when present, otherwise the transaction date.
labels.primary: Any placement with event date 0-29 days after the forecast date.
labels.lead_time_secondary: Any placement 7-36 days after the forecast date, with rows that have a placement 0-6 days after the date removed.

injury_history: Count of placements in the 365 days before the forecast date and an indicator for any placement in the previous calendar season; part of every model.

models.W: Study B features (results history, workload, schedule, current pitch characteristics) plus injury history.
models.V: W plus the fastball velocity change (chg_fb_velo).
models.X: W plus every pitcher-level change feature (chg_*: usage, velocity, movement, spin, extension, release point, arm angle, zone rate) and the per-type shrunk change features from forecast_value_v1.
models.NW/NX: Gradient-boosted trees on W and X features with the forecast_value_v1 fixed tree settings.

priors: Per-type physical-change priors are fitted on the seasons used to fit each model: the inner training seasons while tuning and the outer training seasons for the final fit.
tuning: Logistic C from the study grid and boosted max_iter from [100, 200, 400], chosen by log loss on the inner validation season, then refit on all training seasons.
evaluation: Freeze after development. Download 2025-2026 transactions only after the freeze. Score 2025 (train 2021-2024) and 2026 (train 2021-2025) once, with each model's setting fixed at its 2024-fold choice.

claims.changes_warn: Supported when the pooled 2025-2026 X-W log-loss difference interval lies below zero for the primary label.
claims.otherwise: Reported as not supported, or as harmful when the interval lies above zero.

scoring: Bernoulli log loss per forecast; pitcher-cluster bootstrap with 1000 draws. Descriptive: AUC and the placement rate among each model's top 10% of forecasts.
limits: Strikeout, walk and whiff outcomes for 2025-2026 were already inspected; injured-list outcomes were not. Minor-league injuries, option assignments and unreported injuries are invisible. Overlapping weekly rows share events, handled by clustering on pitcher.
stop_rule: Run development once, freeze, score the evaluation once. Report every comparison and both labels regardless of direction; no feature, label or tuning changes after results.
